# opnsense_interfaces_lagg (Data Source)

Link aggregation devices (**Interfaces ▸ Devices ▸ LAGG**). Members must be unassigned physical interfaces. Never move the interface you manage OPNsense through into a LAGG without console access.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the LAGG.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `device` (String) Device name, e.g. `lagg0`. Assigned by OPNsense when unset.
- `hash` (Set of String) Packet layers hashed for balancing.
- `lacp_fast_timeout` (Boolean) Use the fast LACP timeout.
- `lacp_strict` (String) LACP strict mode: `1`, `0`, or empty for the system default.
- `members` (Set of String) Member interfaces, e.g. `["vtnet2", "vtnet3"]`.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU of the device.
- `primary_member` (String) Member preferred by the `failover` protocol.
- `proto` (String) Aggregation protocol.
- `use_flowid` (String) Use the RSS hash of the network card for balancing: `1`, `0`, or empty for the system default.
